title: VoiceLoop dataset manifest v1
description: Versioned manifest emitted by the dataset builder (P2-05). Carries a content hash, the source call IDs, call-level split assignments and filter counts for audit (context.md sections 2 and 8). Splits are arrays of call IDs, never utterance IDs, so a call cannot leak across splits.

schema_version.description: Exact version of this manifest format; bump and note in docs/CHANGELOG.md on any change.

dataset_id.description: Stable identifier for this versioned dataset.

content_hash.description: Deterministic hash over sorted example identifiers and contents (sha256 hex recommended). Passed to the trainer and logged as lineage.

source_call_ids.description: Every call that contributed at least one example. Full lineage example -> call -> model depends on this list.

splits.description: Assignment of source calls to splits. Values are arrays of call IDs, not counts or utterance IDs; the three arrays must be pairwise disjoint and their union must equal source_call_ids (enforced by the builder and its property tests, not expressible in plain JSON Schema). Golden and regression calls are excluded from train/val/test.

filter_counts.description: Audit counts of rows affected by each dataset rule. Counts are non-negative integers; consent and PII drops are mandatory (context.md section 2 invariant 8).

created_at.description: UTC time when the manifest was built (RFC 3339).

examples.description: Total number of training examples in the built dataset (up to three per reviewed item).

synthetic.description: True if the dataset contains any TTS/noise-augmented or replay-synthesised examples. Synthetic rows must be tagged and kept out of golden and regression sets.

CallIdList.description: List of call IDs assigned to one split.

Count.description: Non-negative count of rows affected by a filter.
